about_the_game:
Welcome to Gem Island, a captivating adventure where survival and exploration await! As a brave adventurer, you find yourself on a lush, isolated island filled with hidden treasures and challenges lying deep beneath the surface.

The demo version of Gem Island features:

  • Deep Exploration: Venture over 100 meters underground, mining up to 8 types of ore that will help you upgrade your gear to go even deeper. The further you dig, the more valuable the ores you’ll discover.

  • Realistic Digging Mechanics: Experience advanced soil and rock destruction technology. Watch as the soil crumbles away from your pickaxe.

  • Your Base: Use the forge to smelt precious ores, the anvil to craft essential tools, and the drill to enhance your equipment. The first aid station will help you recover from injuries sustained in the mines.

  • Dangerous Discoveries: The island is fraught with dangers. Beware of falling rocks when you dig, avoid burning yourself on lava, and try not to fall from great heights. When you reach a certain depth, you will encounter pockets of gas that will explode upon interaction.

  • Upgrade Your Equipment: To succeed in Gem Island, continually improve your tools and gear. Upgrade your pickaxe for faster digging, your axe to gather more wood from each tree, your helmet to protect against falling objects, your boots to reduce fall damage, and your chest armor to shield against burns and explosions.

Will You Uncover the Island's Secrets?

Are you ready to embrace the adventure of a lifetime? Gather your courage, sharpen your skills, and prepare for a thrilling quest to uncover the treasures of Gem Island. The deeper you go, the greater the rewards—are you up for the challenge?
